entries.message: Fix - Stop Trakt watch corrections from stacking duplicate history entries
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Force Sync and watched-date corrections were adding a brand-new Trakt history entry every time they ran, because Trakt's history is an additive play log with no update semantics - repeated corrections piled up duplicate "watched" entries instead of fixing the existing one
Plembfin now removes any existing Trakt plays for a title before replaying its own corrected watched state, so a correction replaces the old entry instead of stacking another one alongside it
A genuine watch reported by Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin still just adds a play, since that really is a new watch

Documented the Trakt play-log limitation and a related one: Plex/Emby/Jellyfin's own mark-played APIs don't accept a backdated date, so those servers still record the moment a correction ran rather than the corrected date itself - confirmed this cannot silently revert a corrected date in Plembfin's own history, since neither the scheduled catch-up sync nor Force Sync ever overwrites an already-recorded watch's date

entries.message: Fix - Repair broken commit-message parsing in the changelog generators
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: The alpha and main changelog generators lost the special separator characters used to split multi-commit git log output when that logic was shared into a new helper file, silently turning every commit message into a stream of single characters instead of parsing them

This made a merged alpha push record itself under the generic "Merge branch..." message with no real details, instead of the actual commit's summary and bullet points - visible as alpha build 2's changelog entry

The alpha changelog generator now also prefers the most recent real commit's message as the entry headline when the triggering commit is an auto-generated merge (routine on this branch, since the bot's own build-bump commit gets folded back on the next push), instead of showing merge plumbing as the changelog title
Corrected the already-published build 2 entry in changelog.alpha.json to show its real changes

entries.message: Fix - Close remaining gaps in cross-platform watch-state sync
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Force Sync no longer records a fake "just watched" date for a title whose played flag has no reliable timestamp on Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin - it is skipped instead of imported with a fabricated date
Unwatching a title now clears its resume/continue-watching position on every connected server, not just the played flag, so a title doesn't keep showing as partially watched after being unwatched

Full Sync now clears a stale resume position for a title that's already unwatched in Plembfin but still shows in-progress on a server, instead of doing nothing because the title isn't watched anywhere
Editing, adding, or bulk-editing a watched date on a media detail page now pushes the corrected date to Trakt and every connected Plex/Emby/Jellyfin server in the background
Emby and Jellyfin now get the same once-a-minute unwatch reconciliation safety net Plex already had, catching a missed or misconfigured webhook instead of leaving a title stuck as watched
Documented all of the above across CLAUDE.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/emby.md, docs/jellyfin.md, docs/media-detail.md, docs/scheduled-sync.md, README, and .env.example

entries.message: Feature - Give alpha builds their own version counter and fix identical log tabs
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Alpha builds now show a distinct version like v0.8.0.7 alpha in the sidebar and Settings -> About, instead of always showing the same trailing version as main; the number increments on every push to the alpha branch and resets automatically the next time alpha is merged into main
Settings -> About now lists an "Alpha builds since last merge" changelog section separate from published releases, generated from the same commit-bullet rules as real release notes
The published alpha Docker image is now also tagged with its specific build number (alpha-<N>) alongside the existing rolling alpha tag, so a specific build can be pinned or identified

Fixed the Settings -> Logs page showing identical content on every category tab: the unfiltered browser debug log trail was being appended under every tab and tab switches auto-scroll to the bottom, so Plex WebSockets/Outbound Sync/Scheduled Polls all looked the same; that trail now only shows under All Logs and System Logs, where it is actually relevant
Documented both changes in CLAUDE.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/development.md, docs/settings.md, and the README
